d128.scope: gfx1250 causal D128, aligned BF16/FP16 normal-scale random QKV; useful causal QK+PV FLOPs. ASM BF16 only.
d128.confidence_method: 2000 hierarchical bootstrap samples of sweeps and paired rounds; 95% percentile interval. Captures observed timing variation, not all hardware or input distributions.
